title: Explicit bottom-boundary mode binding for admitted free-drainage modes

source_bound_problem.current_adapter_dependency: validate_legacy_request requires global swbotb to be 7/-2 and requires request%boundary%bottom_mode == global swbotb
source_bound_problem.current_headcalc_dependency: HeadCalc residual and Jacobian bottom-boundary routing use global swbotb even on the explicit common route
source_bound_problem.architectural_issue: an explicit per-solve boundary mode exists but is not authoritative; this creates avoidable cross-column/global coupling on the admitted common path

implementation_contract.headcalc_explicit_route: when explicit state binding is present, boundary_conditions is required and its bottom_mode becomes the local HeadCalc bottom-mode selector
implementation_contract.headcalc_legacy_route: when explicit state binding is absent, preserve legacy global swbotb exactly
implementation_contract.adapter_explicit_route: validate request bottom_mode directly; do not require equality to legacy global swbotb
implementation_contract.legacy_request_builder: may continue copying legacy global swbotb into a newly built compatibility request
